first.rationale: Activation and onboarding are both declining, and the inherited evidence for signup simplification and shorter onboarding is directly relevant but older and insufficiently specific to the current decline. Verify both before running a guarded simplification test, while monitoring qualified conversion and downstream revenue quality so faster completion does not reduce lead quality or meaningful activation.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding simplification experiment this week, prioritizing the observed activation and completion declines. The verified evidence shows signup simplification increased SMB activation and qualified revenue, while shorter onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and retention. Guard against downstream-value loss by tracking qualified revenue, meaningful activation, and 30-day retention; the prior 1% retention decline from signup simplification warrants segmenting to SMB and retaining a holdout rather than rolling out broadly.
